integrity: Proof is supplied in full; independently runnable diagnostic code checks symbolic identities and examples but does not certify the infinite-time theorem. No experimental ecological claim.
scientific_limitations: Proved only for two small explicit positive open wedges on the upper side of the host fold; does not classify all initial states, exceptional solutions, parameter detuning or global basins.
title: Coupling-renormalized critical oscillations at an additive-Allee fold–flip equilibrium
